categories.name: Electronics
categories.description: Gadgets, devices, and accessories for everyday tech needs.

products.name: UltraSound Wireless Headphones
products.description: Premium over-ear wireless headphones with 40-hour battery life, active noise cancellation, and foldable design. Compatible with all Bluetooth 5.0 devices.

reviews.comment: Best headphones I have ever owned. The noise cancellation is phenomenal and battery lasts forever.
Great sound quality. Slightly tight on the ears after 3 hours but otherwise excellent.

products.name: ProTab X10 Tablet
products.description: 10.5-inch tablet with AMOLED display, 128GB storage, 8GB RAM, and stylus support. Ideal for professionals and students.

reviews.comment: Incredible display and very fast. The stylus support makes it perfect for note-taking.
Good tablet but gets warm during heavy use. Camera is just average.

products.name: SmartCharge 65W GaN Charger
products.description: Compact GaN charger with 65W output, supports USB-C PD and USB-A fast charging. Charges laptops, tablets, and phones simultaneously.

reviews.comment: Replaced three chargers with this one. Incredibly compact and charges my MacBook at full speed.

categories.name: Home & Kitchen
categories.description: Smart and essential products for your home and kitchen.

products.name: BrewMaster Pro Coffee Maker
products.description: 12-cup programmable coffee maker with built-in grinder, keep-warm plate, and brew-strength control. Supports whole beans and ground coffee.

reviews.comment: Makes the best coffee I have had at home. The built-in grinder is a game changer.
Works great. The grinder is slightly loud but the coffee quality is worth it.

products.name: AirPure 360 Air Purifier
products.description: HEPA air purifier covering up to 500 sq ft. Removes 99.97% of dust, pollen, smoke, and allergens. Quiet sleep mode and auto air quality sensor.

reviews.comment: My allergies have significantly improved since I started using this. Quiet at night too.

categories.name: Sports & Fitness
categories.description: Equipment and accessories to support an active lifestyle.

products.name: FitTrack Smart Watch
products.description: Advanced fitness smartwatch with heart rate monitor, SpO2 tracking, GPS, sleep tracking, and 7-day battery life. Water resistant up to 50 meters.

reviews.comment: Accurate GPS and the heart rate monitor is spot on. Battery easily lasts a week.
Great watch for the price. The app could use some improvement but the hardware is solid.

products.name: PowerGrip Adjustable Dumbbells
products.description: Space-saving adjustable dumbbells ranging from 5 to 50 lbs per dumbbell. Selector dial adjusts weight in 5 lb increments. Includes storage tray.

reviews.comment: Replaced an entire rack of dumbbells. The dial mechanism is smooth and reliable.
